subject: Request: Staircase top-up for geo-harmonization — SF -> Dublin transfers
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Staircase top-up for SF->DUB transfers

Hi Marissa / Laura,

Following the org move of two senior engineers from San Francisco to our Dublin site, I'm raising a request for a temporary "staircase" top-up to bring their total cash+benefits in line with the Dublin payband during the 12-month transition. The hires were originally brought on in SF and the relocation required a payband harmonization conversation to avoid an immediate large delta in take-home.

Key facts:
- Employees: Anika Rao (Eng Lead), Samir Patel (Senior SWE)
- Effective relocation: 2027-10-15
- Current SF OTE vs Dublin target gap: Anika ~€18k, Samir ~€11k (annualized)
- Proposal: phased top-up over 6 months (50% / 30% / 20%) to full harmonization, with review at month 6 for benefits alignment.
- Tentative budget code: ENG-RELOC-2027-Q4

Rationale: minimize retention risk, preserve internal equity on team leveling, and avoid sharp take-home drops as cost-of-living and tax differences are reconciled. CompBench sent a short benchmarking note (cc Emily) for Dublin equivalents.

Can you confirm what documentation you need to route this (people partner sign-off, exec approval threshold, payroll timing)? I can share individual breakdowns if helpful.

Thanks,
Vivek
---
Vivek Kulkarni
Engineering Manager, Core Serving
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2027 10:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: Staircase top-up for SF->DUB transfers

Thanks Vivek — this framing is helpful.

Next steps from People Ops:
1) Please submit a short manager justification per employee (role, reason for relocation, business impact).
2) Confirm whether equity refresh or one-time cash is preferred — we typically prefer cash top-ups on relocations but will consider pro-rated refresh in retention-sensitive cases.
3) Provide proposed payment schedule (pay cycle months).

I've attached our initial comp analysis summary (comp-analysis-SF-DUB.pdf) from CompBench for Dublin market medians. Also note the exec-approval threshold for sustained increases is €15k incremental OTE — anything above that needs VP sign-off.

If you can send the manager justifications and the staircase schedule, I'll queue this for Rishi for executive sign-off.

Laura Bennett
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: comp-analysis-SF-DUB.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emily Chen <emily@compbench.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Nov 2027 14:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Staircase top-up for SF->DUB transfers

Laura — thanks. Vivek, I pulled together the manager write-ups and a suggested staircase schedule (attached). High level:

- Anika Rao (Eng Lead): role critical to migration of Core Serving to EMEA infra; recommended top-up total €18,000 annualized, delivered as one-time acceleration broken into three payroll months: €9,000 / €5,400 / €3,600.
- Samir Patel (Sr SWE): high-impact on latency work; recommended top-up total €11,000 annualized, payroll spread €5,500 / €3,300 / €2,200.

Proposal notes:
- Structure as one-time cash top-ups paid over 3 months to avoid repeated tax recalculation and to make payroll clean.
- For equity, propose a light refresh grant in Q1 2028 tied to retention and OKR milestones rather than an immediate grant.
- Budget owner sign-off: ENG-G&A (I will confirm cost center).

Attached: staircase-proposal.xlsx (payment schedule, budget rows, manager comments). Emily — thanks for the comp context; please flag if the Dublin medians should push us to full immediate harmonization.

Marissa Cole
VP, Product & GTM
Redwood Inference
Attachment: staircase-proposal.xlsx
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 09:45:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: Staircase top-up for SF->DUB transfers

Marissa — this looks reasonable. Per policy, anything with an annualized delta > €15k needs VP approval (Rishi, looping you in). I've validated payroll timing with Total Rewards and confirmed the 3-month payout is the cleanest path for Dublin payroll.

I've prepared an approval packet and a DocuSign route to capture VP authorization and cost-center sign-off: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/ABC123-redwood-topup-approval

Requested from Rishi: please sign/approve the packet or advise if you'd like a cap or revision to amounts.

Laura
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 14 Nov 2027 18:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: Staircase top-up for SF->DUB transfers

Apologies for the delayed reply — traveling. I've reviewed the packet and will approve with a minor cap to bring the net budget hit down by ~10%. Please update the staircase spreadsheet with the capped amounts (I've attached my quick CSV to indicate approved numbers) and proceed with DocuSign. Our net approved totals: Anika €16,200, Samir €9,900.

Approval: signed off for payroll processing once DocuSign complete and cost center confirmed.

Rishi Malhotra
VP, Finance & Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: approved_amounts.csv
